title: BridgePoint Global Offline World
description: Download global geographic foundations before connectivity fails. Dynamic feeds and region-specific intelligence are not mislabeled as globally available.

packs.title: Global streets, water and map context
packs.description: Worldwide vector basemap from OpenStreetMap and Natural Earth, clipped to zoom levels 0–6. Designed for a fast global view and broad geographic context; it does not contain high-zoom building or parcel detail.

packs.title: Global country boundaries — three detail levels
packs.description: Download Natural Earth country outlines at 110m, 50m and 10m resolutions. Select the preferred boundary detail while offline.

layerAvailability.title: Detailed buildings and 3D structures
layerAvailability.note: Not included in the global zoom 0–6 basemap. Requires separately built regional geometry packages.

layerAvailability.title: Parcel boundaries and cadastral records
layerAvailability.note: Coverage and redistribution rights vary by jurisdiction; only generated, rights-checked regional packs can be offered.

layerAvailability.title: High-resolution terrain and LiDAR
layerAvailability.note: Global detailed elevation and LiDAR are too large for one practical phone pack; use source-backed region packages.

layerAvailability.title: Aerial and satellite imagery
layerAvailability.note: Imagery is subject to provider licensing and can require very large regional downloads.

layerAvailability.title: Weather, radar and emergency alerts
layerAvailability.note: Only an explicitly dated snapshot can work offline. Live radar and new alerts require connectivity or a separate data feed.

layerAvailability.title: Saved property intelligence and opportunities
layerAvailability.note: User-specific records must be exported only with authorization and stored separately from public geographic packs.
